## Bearer

## Trigger

ExerciseSessionManager, constructed with an ExerciseSessionSystem — nothing observes it: no Hilt module, factory or other wiring in app-wear's main source supplies a real instance; only fake implementations exist, in the test sources.

## Today

`ExerciseSessionSystem` is only an interface, in
app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/sensor/session/ExerciseSessionSystem.kt,
declaring `availableDataTypes()`, `startExerciseSession()`,
`endExerciseSession()` and `setDataDeliveryMode()`. Every implementation
found is a test fake — `FakeExerciseSessionSystem`,
`FakeControlExerciseSessionSystem`, `FakeEndOfRaceExerciseSessionSystem`,
`StoppingFakeExerciseSessionSystem` — each confined to its own test
file under app-wear/src/test. `ExerciseSessionManager`
(app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/sensor/session/ExerciseSessionManager.kt)
drives the interface — `open()`, `close()`, `isDataTypeAvailable()`,
`onInteractivityChanged()` — but nothing in app-wear's main source
constructs it with a real `ExerciseSessionSystem`: no Hilt module,
`@Provides`/`@Binds` function, or other wiring was found anywhere
under app-wear/src/main. `gradle/libs.versions.toml` lists no Health
Services dependency — only `play-services-wearable`, `androidx-core-ktx`
and Compose/coroutines/test entries — and no Hilt dependency at all.

## Expected

`ExerciseSessionSystem` has a real implementation, wrapping Health
Services' `ExerciseClient`: `getCapabilitiesAsync()` backs
`availableDataTypes()`, `startExerciseAsync()`/`endExerciseAsync()`
back `startExerciseSession()`/`endExerciseSession()`, and the exercise
config's batching interval backs `setDataDeliveryMode()` — per the
interface's own doc comment and TECHNICAL_CONVENTIONS.md section 6.
This requires adding the Health Services SDK
(`androidx.health:health-services-client`) to `gradle/libs.versions.toml`
and as a dependency of `:app-wear`, since no such entry exists today.
Something in `:app-wear`'s main source — a Hilt module or equivalent —
must also construct `ExerciseSessionManager` with this real
implementation, since nothing does today and `ExerciseSessionManager`
is otherwise only ever built with a fake.
